name: Call Upon Faith
body:
School conjuration; Level cleric/oracle 1, paladin 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF Call Lesser Demon

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 min./level or until discharged; see text

DESCRIPTION

You call upon your deity to assist you in a task you are facing. You receive a +3 sacred bonus on any one ability check or skill check. Once you attempt the skill or ability check, the spell expires (whether the check succeeds or not).
